svg.title: Parts list
svg.desc: Ai: Claude Code, Anthropic and OpenAI APIs, LangChain, Model Context Protocol, Hugging Face. Languages: Java, Kotlin, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go. Backend: Spring Boot, WebFlux, Quarkus, Apache Camel, Vert.x, Node.js, NestJS. Frontend: Angular, React, Vue, Next.js. Data And Events: Kafka (Confluent), Debezium, GCP Pub/Sub, PostgreSQL, Oracle, MongoDB, Redis, DynamoDB. Cloud And Devops: AWS, GCP, Azure, OpenShift, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, GitHub Actions, Keycloak, Kong. Observability: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo. Quality: JUnit, Testcontainers, Cypress, k6, Gatling, chaos engineering, SonarQube.
